tasks.brief: Implementation constraints: Edit src/services/models.py in-place. Read NEMOTRON_URL from os.environ with default 'http://localhost:8600' at import time. Create three constants: NEMOTRON_BASE_URL, NEMOTRON_CHAT_ENDPOINT, NEMOTRON_READY_URL. Use exact names. Do not change imports, do not change any other code, do not add functions. Behavioral specification: NEMOTRON_BASE_URL = os.environ.get('NEMOTRON_URL', 'http://localhost:8600'); NEMOTRON_CHAT_ENDPOINT = NEMOTRON_BASE_URL + '/v1/chat/completions'; NEMOTRON_READY_URL = NEMOTRON_BASE_URL + '/v1/models'. Acceptance condition: The three constants exist with exact names and derive from the env var; default is http://localhost:8600; all existing tests in tests/test_models_service.py, tests/test_models_api.py, tests/test_chat_model_routing.py, and tests/test_nemotron_config.py pass.

Implementation constraints: Edit src/static/app.js in-place. Two edits: (1) In the 'error' event branch inside processFrame and in the fetch .catch at the end of the submit handler, push { role: 'user', content: message } into currentThread.messages only if not already present, then call persistThreads(). Do not push assistant messages. Do not alter the 'done' branch. (2) After reply bubble creation, set its text to 'thinking...'. In the token/think render seam where replyBubble.innerHTML = renderThink(replyText) runs, if the rendered visible text is empty (all think-spans or nothing), show 'thinking...'; otherwise show the rendered result. The placeholder must never enter stored history. Behavioral specification: Failed replies retain the user message in history. A 'thinking...' placeholder appears immediately after bubble creation and clears once visible answer text streams. Acceptance condition: tests/test_ui.py::test_failed_reply_keeps_user_message and tests/test_ui.py::test_thinking_placeholder_shows_then_clears pass, plus all other tests/test_ui.py::* tests pass.
